title: QDC Quantum Potion Overload
description: Remove, Add and Extend duration of potion effects. Can only use potions discovered by the Core Mod, QDC CORE 4.5, which is required for the mod.
body:
This mod allows the user to Add, Remove and Extend, potion effects on the player.

It requires QDC CORE 4.5 as a Core Mod, since it depends on the potions discovered by the Core Mod Disassembly and Discovery mechanic.

To Add and Extend a potion effect, particles from the Core Mod are required.

When removing a potion effect, if the potion with the effect has been discovered, the player will recieve particles. If potion of the effect being removed is not discovered, the effect can still be removed but no particles will be gained.


![Main GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c3fce5f0fbd3931bf78b8007320af68ff38c3ed0.png)

Click on a potion effect in the "Potion Effects on Player" window to extract and remove a potion effect.

![Main GUI Potion Effect Remove](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/168aff8fc25eb71bf92a0baae0cdddfca9ac1e5e.png)

Click on a potion effect in the "Discovered Potion Effect List" window, to Add a potion effect or Extend the duration of a potion effect. This requires the player to have particles from the Core Mod.

![Main GUI Add Extend Potion Effect](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b425094118a0cc0e80282e0694b83a75104251e7.png)
